text.setup: Bar on your front delts, fingertips under it, elbows high. Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
cues: Keep your elbows up the whole time.
Sit straight down between your heels with your torso upright.
Drive up, leading with your elbows.
mistakes: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward.

variants.barbell: If the rack position hurts your wrists, crossed arms or straps on the bar work too.
